scientific_integrity: An exact conditional distributional result under independent fresh Brownian explorations with Poisson interruption. Classical renewal and hyperbolic identities are credited as prior theory.
scientific_limitations: Requires a common initial/reset site, inactive targets during returns, and independent fresh exploration and clock after each complete history. Return durations can depend on past history. Bressloff's multiple-target original was not read in full. Heavy-tailed overhead can make conditional total-time moments infinite.
title: An infinitely divisible conditional-exit delay survives arbitrary reset-return overhead
